denominator: same day/same both-known stock members, fixed future 1709/90 research pool NON-PIT
event: FALSE->TRUE only for main study; UNKNOWN->TRUE and LEFT_CENSORED separately, never silently promoted. Full panel shifted before window filter.

position: Independent slots, not a capital account. 1.2m reference NAV; initial max0.5%NAV per name, <=2 names/event; one add max0.5%NAV/name; slot capital max1%NAV; baseline fee-inclusive stop-reference loss cap0.125%NAV/slot; quantity sensitivity0.0625%,0.25% at identical entries. add: Only first unused original stock CP1 receipt, current I valid, industry current robust qualification TRUE, whole stock round net liquidation at close >0 after all fees, and rechecked at next open; no averaging down. One add maximum in this finite contract, no tuning.
exit: Core uses original I_structure_exit, next common open; add uses original CP1_add_protection with trailing max(I floor, fresh CP candidate). Industry decline only stops new buys/adds, never forced sell. Original account ACT/cash/global protection must also gate deployed strategy, but cannot be inferred for a new account from old account P&L.
execution: Signal known close, next common open +/-5bp; dated native commission/minimum5/levies/stamp/quantity rules; A-share T+1. Missing price, source switch/gap, corporate action/factor change => UNKNOWN (not dropped), right-censor => OPEN_CENSORED. Historical limit/suspension orderability UNKNOWN for every proxy fill.
resources: Original account next-open snapshot overlay is a separate necessary-condition rejection screen only, after its original reservations; does not prove positive admission nor reuse its trade P&L.
